const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path('.').resolve()
manifest = load_manifest()
runtime = LuaRuntime(manifest)
runtime.doctor()
loader = LocaleLoader(runtime)
current = loader.load_path(root / 'tome-cults.lua', logical_path='tome-cults.lua')
head_bytes = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tome-cults.lua'], cwd=root, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
head = loader.load_bytes(head_bytes, logical_path='tome-cults.lua')
baseline = json.loads((root / '.ai/task/repair-w36-20260926/BASELINE-records.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['tome-cults.lua']
assert len(current.records) == len(head.records), (len(current.records), len(head.records))
changed = []
for i, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(head.records, current.records)):
    stable_before = {k: v for k, v in before.items() if k not in ('line', 'target')}
    stable_after = {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k not in ('line', 'target')}
    assert stable_before == stable_after, ('non-target mutation', i, before, after)
    if before.get('target') != after.get('target'):
        assert before.get('kind') == 'translation'
        changed.append((before, after))
assert len(changed) == 21, len(changed)
def key(r): return (r['section'], r['source'], r.get('source_tag'))
assert len({key(r) for r in baseline}) == 21
assert {key(b) for b, a in changed} == {key(r) for r in baseline}
base_by_key = {key(r): r for r in baseline}
for before, after in changed:
    frozen = base_by_key[key(before)]
    assert before['target'] == frozen['target'], ('preimage mismatch', key(before))
    s_lines = after['source'].split('\n')
    t_lines = after['target'].split('\n')
    assert len(s_lines) == len(t_lines), ('line count', key(after), len(s_lines), len(t_lines))
    assert [i for i, x in enumerate(s_lines) if x.strip() == ''] == [i for i, x in enumerate(t_lines) if x.strip() == ''], ('blank index', key(after))
    for n, (s, t) in enumerate(zip(s_lines, t_lines), 1):
        st = len(s) - len(s.lstrip('\t'))
        tt = len(t) - len(t.lstrip('\t'))
        assert st == tt, ('leading tabs', key(after), n, st, tt, repr(s), repr(t))
        assert not re.search(r'[ \t]+$', t), ('target trailing whitespace', key(after), n, repr(t))
    sx = re.findall(r'<\?=.*?\?>', after['source'], flags=re.S)
    tx = re.findall(r'<\?=.*?\?>', after['target'], flags=re.S)
    assert sx == tx, ('template expression mismatch', key(after), sx, tx)
assert current.sha256 != head.sha256
print(f'LuaJIT semantic load: PASS ({len(current.translations)} translations)')
print(f'Target-only semantic diff: PASS ({len(changed)} changed targets, exact frozen workset)')
print('LF/TAB/blank-line/trailing-whitespace/template checks: PASS (21/21)')
